legend: You are given a rectangle grid. That grid's size is n × m. Let's denote the coordinate system on the grid. So, each point on the grid will have coordinates — a pair of integers (x, y) (0 ≤ x ≤ n, 0 ≤ y ≤ m).

Your task is to find a maximum sub-rectangle on the grid (x1, y1, x2, y2) so that it contains the given point (x, y), and its length-width ratio is exactly (a, b). In other words the following conditions must hold: 0 ≤ x1 ≤ x ≤ x2 ≤ n, 0 ≤ y1 ≤ y ≤ y2 ≤ m, ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/0c36d1eac2611e4dc89474c61ba622f0db130f00.png).
The sides of this sub-rectangle should be parallel to the axes. And values x1, y1, x2, y2 should be integers.

If there are multiple solutions, find the rectangle which is closest to (x, y). Here "closest" means the Euclid distance between (x, y) and the center of the rectangle is as small as possible. If there are still multiple solutions, find the lexicographically minimum one. Here "lexicographically minimum" means that we should consider the sub-rectangle as sequence of integers (x1, y1, x2, y2), so we can choose the lexicographically minimum one.
input: The first line contains six integers n, m, x, y, a, b (1 ≤ n, m ≤ 109, 0 ≤ x ≤ n, 0 ≤ y ≤ m, 1 ≤ a ≤ n, 1 ≤ b ≤ m).
output: Print four integers x1, y1, x2, y2, which represent the founded sub-rectangle whose left-bottom point is (x1, y1) and right-up point is (x2, y2).

legend.ai: 给定一个矩形网格。该网格的大小为 n × m。我们定义网格上的坐标系。因此，网格上的每个点都有坐标——一对整数 (x, y) (0 ≤ x ≤ n, 0 ≤ y ≤ m)。

你的任务是在网格上找到一个最大的子矩形 (x1, y1, x2, y2)，使其包含给定点 (x, y)，且其长宽比恰好为 (a, b)。换句话说，必须满足以下条件：0 ≤ x1 ≤ x ≤ x2 ≤ n, 0 ≤ y1 ≤ y ≤ y2 ≤ m, ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/0c36d1eac2611e4dc89474c61ba622f0db130f00.png)。
该子矩形的边应与坐标轴平行。并且 x1, y1, x2, y2 的值应为整数。
如果有多个解，请找出距离 (x, y) 最近的矩形。这里，“最近”指 (x, y) 与矩形中心之间的欧氏距离尽可能小。如果仍有多个解，请找出字典序最小的解。这里，“字典序最小”意味着我们应将子矩形视为整数序列 (x1, y1, x2, y2)，从而选择字典序最小的那个。

input.ai: 第一行包含六个整数 n, m, x, y, a, b（1 ≤ n, m ≤ 10^9，0 ≤ x ≤ n，0 ≤ y ≤ m，1 ≤ a ≤ n，1 ≤ b ≤ m）。

output.ai: 输出四个整数 x1, y1, x2, y2，表示找到的子矩形，其左下点为 (x1, y1)，右上点为 (x2, y2)。
